confirmatory_firewall.confirmatory_rows: decode only the first CSV field needed to identify atoll/spatial block; species and presence bytes must not be Unicode-decoded, logged, counted by class, summarized, or retained
confirmatory_firewall.excluded_model_target_rows: same semantic ceiling as confirmatory rows
confirmatory_firewall.pilot_rows: species and presence may be decoded only after the atoll is proven to belong to a frozen burned-pilot spatial block

fixed_pilot_species_universe.eligibility: species has native presence code N in at least two distinct frozen burned-pilot spatial blocks
output_after_pilot: SHA-256 of newline-delimited sorted species list

pilot_surface_rule.catalogue_qualified_atoll: pilot atoll having at least one plant row in the source dataset, whose source documentation states that included vascular-plant inventories are complete
pilot_surface_rule.target_one: fixed pilot-supported species has N in held-out catalogue atoll
pilot_surface_rule.target_zero: fixed pilot-supported species has I or has no row in held-out complete catalogue
pilot_surface_rule.non_estimable: no catalogue-qualified held-out atoll or empty fixed pilot-supported species universe
pilot_surface_rule.empty_block_encoding: emit exactly one row with blank target so the frozen partition unit remains visible to v0.32/v0.42
pilot_surface_rule.row_order: frozen pilot_partition order; within block sort catalogue atoll then fixed species lexicographically
